title: Tim Dooley — Prediction Epiphany & Causal Genealogy — 2026
status: canonical genealogy supplement; does not alter strict fulfilled count
purpose: Show how later explicit predictions grew out of earlier revelations, epiphanies, causal models, metaphors and design insights. Preserve the difference between a precursor insight and a scored prediction so stronger provenance does not inflate the hit count.
rules: A precursor may strengthen genealogy and lead time without becoming a separate hit.
Exact user wording is separated from recovered paraphrase.
Assistant-created numerical extrapolations are never back-attributed to Tim.
A revelation/story request stays in revelation form even when later events resemble it.
Publicly knowable prior trends reduce surprise and must remain attached to the record.
When a later clean prediction emerges from an earlier mechanism, link them rather than count both independently.
